---
description: Perform a structured architecture review before production implementation.
mode: agent
---

Review `/docs/architecture.md` against `/docs/requirements.md`. Evaluate
correctness, security, failure handling, scope, resource limits, and
testability. Record findings, risk mitigations, and agreed decisions in
`/docs/design-review.md`. Update the architecture when a finding requires a
change. Do not begin production implementation until the design is approved.
